summary: Verified iteration-24 acceptance criteria (trial-only paywall gating for anonymous users, full paywall for header Get Started, login modal for header Sign in, default-to-Word tab, backend variants + Connection:close header). Added new pytest module test_iteration24_backend.py (3/3 pass) and ran a Playwright script against the preview URL covering all 8 anonymous-user acceptance items. All checks pass. The trial form submit shows a 'email_send_failed' toast because Resend is in test mode and rejects example.com (per review request, this is acceptable and reported).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py startup ingest triggers a 30-90s YouTube playlist/videos crawl on every uvicorn reload; because watchfiles reloads on any /app/backend/** change (including tests/*.py), running pytest against files inside /app/backend/tests can knock the origin over until the ingest finishes and can leave the singleton MongoClient in the 'Cannot use MongoClient after close' state (seen once during this run; recovered with `supervisorctl restart backend`). Consider gating startup ingest behind an env flag when RUN_ENV=test, or moving tests to /app/tests/ so watchfiles ignores them. This is dev-quality only, not a production bug.

PaywallModal plan buttons use `data-testid="paywall-${lookup_key}"` (paywall-accent_coach_monthly / paywall-accent_coach_yearly). The review-request selector convention `[data-testid^=paywall-plan]` would miss them — no functional issue, just call out the naming mismatch for future automation.

TrialSignupForm surfaces raw Resend error codes to the toast ('email_send_failed'). Consider translating to a friendly copy ('We couldn't send the sign-in link to that address — try a real inbox.') so future user-facing failures don't leak underscore_snake_case error codes.
